summary: Iter15 (BUG + 3 features batch) fully validated. Backend 23/23 pytest PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter15_search_and_admin.py). Frontend Playwright end-to-end on the live preview URL: dashboard/transactions debounced search returns real-time results (case-insensitive lookup by BTP-reference in lowercase surfaces the row, XOF currency filter returns row, unknown query renders [data-testid=tx-empty] with 'Aucune transaction trouvée.'); dashboard/transfer shows exactly 3 tabs (biz_to_biz, biz_to_mobile, biz_to_crypto) — no biz_to_bank tab and no 'Compte bancaire' text on page; admin/transactions debounced search by merchant email substring surfaces our seeded tx (via user_id join), unknown query shows admin-tx-empty; admin/links page renders with search+status+row testids; admin/api page lists our fresh merchant and exposes suspend/regen/delete action buttons; admin/users action menu shows 'Convertir en Personnel' MenuItem (data-testid=act-account-type-{uid}) which opens ModalShell (switch-type-modal-{uid}) with 'Confirmer la conversion' — clicking it triggers PATCH /admin/users/{uid} and displays 'Compte converti en Personnel' success toast (verified in screenshot); admin/transfer-config has no btn-add-bank testid and no 'Compte bancaire' text. Backend coverage: search-by-id, search-by-reference (exact + lowercase + substring), search-by-currency, empty-search, admin search by user email/username/case-insensitive, biz_to_bank rejected with 410 'Le transfert bancaire n'est plus disponible…', PATCH admin/users {account_type:'merchant'} on a personal user immediately provisions API keys (GET /api-keys goes from 403 → 200 with pk_test_ key), reverse direction merchant→personal works, /admin/links returns links with owner enrichment (username/email/account_type), search by owner-email substring surfaces the link, suspend action → /links/pay returns 404 for that slug (active=false filter), reactivate flips active back to true, delete cascades (link and link_payments removed), /admin/api-keys NEVER returns secret_hash/secret_encrypted/secret_key (only test_public_key + live_public_key + suspended flag), suspend action → subsequent POST /v1/payments with the merchant's sk_test_ returns 403 'Clés API suspendues par l'administrateur', reactivate lifts the 403, regenerate rotates the public key AND invalidates the previously issued plaintext sk_test_ (POST /v1/payments returns 401 with the old key), delete removes the api_keys doc entirely.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2867 lines — router-split is severely overdue; every iteration accretes ~50-150 lines into the monolith and it's making cross-cutting search/admin logic hard to keep DRY (the /transactions and /admin/transactions $or arrays duplicate 14 identical fields — extract a _tx_search_query(q) helper).

GET /admin/users/{user_id} response envelope: my Playwright verification of PATCH admin/users called the GET and received an object without a top-level account_type key — but the PATCH response itself DOES include it (backend test asserts r.json()['account_type']=='merchant'). Worth double-checking the GET/{id} shape isn't wrapped ({user: {...}}) inconsistently with PATCH — could confuse consumers. Not a blocker for iter15.

admin/api-keys/{uid}/action/regenerate rotates keys but does NOT emit a plaintext reveal to the admin — admin's regenerate is destructive-only (merchant can no longer authenticate) with no way for admin to hand a new key back. Probably intentional (admin shouldn't handle merchant secrets) but worth documenting in the UI.
admin_link_action delete removes link_payments cascade but does NOT touch merchant_payments or transactions history — that's likely correct (audit trail) but worth documenting.

Search-empty state shows generic 'Aucune transaction trouvée' — nice UX. But when transactions do exist and search returns none, the old table skeleton disappears with no 'try clearing filters' hint. Optional polish.

AdminApi.js `q` state is fed to backend as query param but backend regex includes matching on user_id/public_key only — admin might type a common word and get 0 results without knowing why. Consider always joining users → api_keys so a merchant with only owner-name match still surfaces (current code does add user_ids to $or, so this is fine actually — false alarm on re-read).

The AdminUsers 'act-account-type' MenuItem shows before the KYC/suspend items — placement seems intentional (admin flow). Good touch: the modal explains merchant privileges granted/lost with clear consequences.
biz_to_bank rejection at line 391 is duplicated at line 487 (dead branch — the earlier check makes the second unreachable). Cosmetic dead-code cleanup only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 UI flows: dashboard-tx debounced search + empty, transfer no-bank, admin-tx by-email + empty, admin-links renders, admin-api renders + row + action buttons, admin-users convert-to-personnel modal flow with success toast, admin-transfer-config no-bank)

rca of the issue: No unresolved issues. The reported search bug is fully fixed — MongoDB regex $or across 15 fields with case-insensitive option, escaped user input, and 250ms debounce on the frontend produces real-time results. Admin search additionally joins the users collection to allow email/username/full_name/phone search (via user_id $in). biz_to_bank 410 rejection blocks both /transfers and (frontend) doesn't render the tab. account_type PATCH auto-provisions API keys via idempotent _ensure_api_keys(user_id). Suspended API keys are enforced in _authenticate_merchant() at server.py:1215 returning 403 before the merchant record is loaded — verified end-to-end (create key → post payment 200 → admin suspend → post payment 403 → admin reactivate → post payment 200 → admin regenerate → old key 401).
